The workshop is built around an **overview** lecture (Lec 00) plus thirteen topic lectures, paired **1:1:1** with the hands-on tutorials and the book chapters. Read each lecture before working the matching tutorial.

## Lecture series

| # | Lecture | Pairs with |
|---|---|---|
| 00 | [Bulk vs. Single-Cell RNA-seq: What & How](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_00_Bulk_vs_scRNAseq.html) | (overview — sets up everything below) |
| 01 | [Pre-processing: QC, doublets, normalization, HVGs](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_01_Preprocessing.html) | [Tutorial 01 — QC & Preprocessing](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_01_QC_Preprocessing.html) |
| 02 | [Dimensionality Reduction & Clustering](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_02_DimReduction_Clustering.html) | [Tutorial 02 — DimRed & Clustering](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_02_DimReduction_Clustering.html) |
| 03 | [Markers & Manual Cell-Type Annotation](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_03_Markers_Annotation.html) | [Tutorial 03 — Markers & Annotation](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_03_Markers_Annotation.html) |
| 04 | [Reference-based Annotation: SingleR & Azimuth](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_04_Reference_Annotation.html) | [Tutorial 04 — Reference Annotation](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_04_Reference_Annotation.html) |
| 05 | [Multi-Sample Integration](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_05_Integration.html) | [Tutorial 05 — Two-Sample Integration](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_05_Integration.html) |
| 06 | [DESeq2: Bulk Fundamentals + Pseudobulk DE](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_06_DESeq2_DE.html) | [Tutorial 06 — DESeq2: Bulk Primer + Pseudobulk DE](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_06_DESeq2_DE.html) |
| 07 | [Functional Analysis: GO, GSEA, Reactome](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_07_FunctionalAnalysis.html) | [Tutorial 07 — Functional Analysis](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_07_FunctionalAnalysis.html) |
| 08 | [Differential Abundance with miloR](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_08_DifferentialAbundance.html) | [Tutorial 08 — Differential Abundance](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_08_DifferentialAbundance.html) |
| 09 | [Bulk & Single-Cell ATAC-seq](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_09_ATACseq.html) | [Tutorial 09 — scATAC-seq with Signac](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_09_scATACseq_Signac.html) |
| 10 | [WGCNA: Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_10_WGCNA.html) | [Tutorial 10 — WGCNA on GSE152418](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_10_WGCNA.html) |
| 11 | [Spatial Transcriptomics: Gene Expression in Tissue Context](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_11_Spatial.html) | [Tutorial 11 — Spatial Transcriptomics](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_11_Spatial_Transcriptomics.html) |
| 12 | [Trajectory Inference & Cell–Cell Communication](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_12_Trajectory_CellCommunication.html) | [Tutorial 12 — Trajectory & Cell–Cell Communication](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_12_Trajectory_CellCommunication.html) |
| 13 | [FAIR Principles & Data Sharing](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_13_FAIR_DataSharing.html) | [Tutorial 13 — FAIR Metadata & Submission](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_13_FAIR_Metadata.html) |

Each lecture also has a **companion book chapter** (Chapter 0–13) under [Readings](Readings.qmd) that covers the same material in long-form prose with worked examples and cross-references to the prerequisite appendices (A–K).

## Pre-requisite computational background

The pre-requisite computational tools (computing fundamentals, Unix, R, Git, HPC) are not presented as lectures. They live as long-form reading material under [Readings](Readings.qmd).
